info.name: HevolveBot LangChain Agent API
info.description:
Complete API collection for HevolveBot LangChain Agent.

Server runs on port 6778 (Waitress).

Protected endpoints require X-API-Key header.
Set the `api_key` collection variable to match your HEVOLVE_API_KEY in .env.

request.description:
Health check endpoint. No auth required.

Expected: {"response": "Working..."}

body.raw:
{
  "user_id": "{{user_id}}",
  "prompt": "Hello, what can you do?",
  "request_id": "test_001",
  "create_agent": false,
  "casual_conv": true
}

request.description:
Chat endpoint in simple conversation mode (reuse existing agent).

Requires: X-API-Key header

Fields:
- user_id (required): User identifier
- prompt (required): User message
- request_id: Request tracking ID
- create_agent: false = reuse, true = create new agent
- casual_conv: true = casual mode

Chat endpoint in agent creation mode.

Requires: X-API-Key header

Fields:
- user_id (required): User identifier
- prompt (required): Agent creation instructions
- prompt_id (required for create): Links to prompt definition
- create_agent: true = enter creation flow

request.description:
Chat endpoint with ALL optional fields shown.

Requires: X-API-Key header

Fields:
- user_id (required): User identifier
- prompt (required): User message
- request_id: Request tracking ID
- create_agent: false/true
- casual_conv: Casual conversation mode (default true)
- preferred_lang: Language code (default "en")
- tools: Specific tools to enable
- file_id: File attachment ID
- prompt_id: Links to prompt definition
- probe: Debug flag
- intermediate: Intermediate response flag

Time-based agent for scheduled task execution.

Requires: X-API-Key header

Fields:
- user_id (required): User identifier
- prompt_id (required): Agent/prompt ID
- task_description (required): What to schedule
- request_from: "Reuse" (default) or "Create"

Visual Language Model agent for image/vision tasks.

Requires: X-API-Key header

Fields:
- user_id (required): User identifier
- prompt_id (required): Agent/prompt ID
- task_description (required): Vision task description
- request_from: "Reuse" (default) or "Create"

query.description: Required: User ID to list prompts for

request.description:
List prompts for a user. Local-first, cloud DB fallback.

No auth required.

Query params:
- user_id (required): User identifier

Create or update a single prompt. Auto-assigns prompt_id if not provided.

No auth required.

Fields:
- name: Display name for the agent
- prompt: Goal/description
- user_id: Creator user ID
- prompt_id (optional): Specify to update existing

Create multiple prompts in a single request.

No auth required.

Fields:
- listprompts: Array of prompt objects, each with name, prompt, user_id

Add a human/AI message pair to conversation history.

Requires: X-API-Key header

Fields:
- user_id (required): User identifier
- human_msg (required): The human's message
- ai_msg (required): The AI's response

Acknowledge receipt of a response.

Requires: X-API-Key header

Note: This endpoint currently has a bug - missing return statement (returns 500).

Fields:
- user_id (required): User identifier
- request_id (required): Request to acknowledge
- prompt_id: Associated prompt ID

Zero-shot text classification (single label).

No auth required.

Fields:
- input_text (required): Text to classify
- labels (required): Array of candidate labels
- multi_label: false = pick one best label (default)

response.name: 200 - Sports classified
response.body: {"labels":["sports","entertainment","politics"],"scores":[0.95,0.05,0.0],"sequence":"The team scored a goal in the final minute of the match"}

request.description:
Zero-shot text classification (multi-label).

No auth required.

Fields:
- input_text (required): Text to classify
- labels (required): Array of candidate labels
- multi_label: true = multiple labels can apply, scores don't sum to 1
